property_summary: For every caller and uint _val, in the reference contract SetMinSum(...) always succeeds (does not revert) when called before Initialized() has been set true (i.e., when intitalized == false) allowing MinSum to be updated; the mutant inverts the require and thus will revert for those inputs, breaking that rule.
change_summary: Replace require(!intitalized) with require(intitalized) so SetMinSum only succeeds after initialization, changing MinSum observable behavior.
